components.name: PSGD Kronecker factors Q0 (m×m) and Q1 (n×n)
components.applies_to: all 72 hidden matrices (two sides each): 768²+768² = 2× per attention matrix, 3072²+768² = 4.25× per MLP matrix → 0.67 + 2.83

aux_note: AdamW (fused) m and v on embedding, LM head and 1-D params
notes: Q0 and Q1 are stored as dense fp32 m×m and n×n matrices (no max-dimension rule, so 3072×3072 on each MLP matrix's long side), although only their upper triangles are non-zero, so about half of the 3.5× is structural zeros. The products Q0ᵀQ0, Q1ᵀQ1 and the Gaussian probes are rebuilt every step and are not kept.
evidence: init_psgd: Q0 = torch.eye(m, dtype=torch.float32) * s; Q1 = torch.eye(n, dtype=torch.float32) * s
PSGDKron.step: state["Q0"], state["Q1"] = init_psgd(grad); state["exp_avg"] = torch.zeros_like(grad) with grad = p.grad.squeeze().float()
psgd_update_precond: Q0.sub_(precond_lr / ell0 * torch.triu(AAt - BBt) @ Q0) (likewise Q1): updated in place, stays upper-triangular
optimizer2 = PSGDKron(hidden_matrix_params = [p for p in model.blocks.parameters() if p.ndim >= 2])
optimizer1 = torch.optim.AdamW(embed / head / scalar groups, betas=(0.8, 0.95), fused=True): exp_avg + exp_avg_sq per aux param
